name: branding-condensed-slashed-o-skincare-wordmark
title: Condensed bold wordmark with slashed O for a skincare brand
whatItIs: A white presentation slide with a black condensed wordmark 'ØKYS' in the centre and four tiny caps labels at the corners (logos and marks, designer credit, brand, category).
whatItMeans: Strong, clinical and modern; the slashed O adds a Nordic twist and a distinctive detail.
techniques: Use a tall condensed sans for a strong, stable shape.
Replace one letter with a diacritic (Ø) as the single ownable detail.
Place small caption labels in the four corners as a frame.
Keep pure black on white with lots of empty space.

vocabulary.definition: A narrow sans-serif with tall proportions.
An O with a diagonal stroke through it.
Small text in the four corners of a slide.
A distinctive feature that makes a wordmark unique.
